sources.title: IIJ August 2026 operating data-center inventory (Japanese)
sources.summary: The August 7 operator presentation explicitly reports thirteen operated data centers as of August 2026 and identifies Matsue DCP and Shiroi DCC as the two owned facilities. The Matsue column distinguishes Site 1 IT modules, the system-module building and Site 2. PDF page 45, printed page 44.
sources.date_semantics: August 7 is the dated operator confirmation of its current August inventory, not an opening or completion date. The inventory month is preserved separately; no exact activation day within August is inferred.

sources.title: IIJ August 2026 operating data-center inventory (English)
sources.summary: Official English counterpart to the August 7 presentation identifies Matsue and Shiroi as the owned data centers among thirteen operated facilities as of August 2026. Other facilities are leased from data-center providers. PDF page 45, printed page 44.
sources.date_semantics: Official translation corroborates the same operator disclosure; it is not an independent physical observation. August 7 is publication, not inauguration.

sources.date_semantics: Undated identity or spatial context only. Retrieval date is not a lifecycle observation.

source_reuse: These exact source objects are retained from the ninth release. Their historical source IDs contain Matsue, but the original presentations cover both Matsue and Shiroi. All source metadata and captures are unchanged.
